answer: Random jury of 9 drawn without replacement per verdict. An attacker holding fraction k of identities needs all 9 seats, probability k^9. The delta between honest and sybil juror pools is measurable each epoch; ivory-list nodes with verified stake raise sampling weight. The horizon where a farm wins is k=0.5 → 0.2%, so scaling to 10% coverage bankrupts them before any verdict lands. This works because jury capture cost grows exponentially while sybil identity cost stays linear.
